vis_color_point_cloud: visualize a colored 3D point cloud projected onto a base image using a camera model
vis_pointcloud_error: export ground truth and estimated pose point clouds as a colored PLY mesh file
vis_pca_feature_map: visualize a PCA-projected feature map as an RGB image at a given resolution
set_bg_to_gray: replace low-intensity background pixels in an image with a specified gray level
vis_inference_results: generate a multi-row visualization of object pose estimation inference results with matched templates and correspondences
